svg.title: Base-induced elimination from a vicinal chloroiodide

g.text: Base-induced elimination from a vicinal chloroiodide
KOH (1.3 equiv) in water with tetrabutylammonium bromide (5 mol%)
DBU or diisopropylethylamine in diethyl ether or 1,2-dimethoxyethane
6a + 6b only. Products were not isolated in pure form. No isolated yield was reported.
